title: Total credits offered
statementMd:
What is the total number of credits across all courses?

Expected columns: `total_credits`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT SUM(credits) AS total_credits FROM courses;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
